PLAN "12-Week General Strength Programme for Post-Disc-Herniation Client"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with spine-friendly guidelines; avoid heavy spinal loading and loaded spinal flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Push emphasis (SB safe)":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x max rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull/Back emphasis (neutral spine)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Body Stability (no spinal flexion load)":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Push Focus with safer ROM":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Pull + Grip":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_back_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body + Core (controlled loading)":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Strength & Progression":
        warmup:
          walk 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_thoracic_mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Posterior Chain & Core (safe)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower Body Strength/Stability":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Volume Maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x max rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Back & Lat Work":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x30-45 seconds rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. Wrong: 3x8-12.
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (canonical names):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES:
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes:
- This program emphasizes spine-friendly mechanics: avoid loaded spinal flexion and heavy spinal loading. Substitutions and exercise selections prioritize neutral spine and progressive overload within safe ROM.
- If client experiences symptoms, scale load, tempo, or ROM and consult clinician before progressing.
- Ensure core stability work and mobility work integrated as needed by client tolerance.
